svg.text: The access group ID in a rule is the Identity Center group ID sent in memberOf, not the group's display name.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Client CIDR between /12 and /22, fixed at creation. Session timeout 8 h. Controls supported: AC-17(1), AC-17(2), IA-2(1), IA-8, AC-3, AC-6, AU-12, SC-8.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not AWS artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
